faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.refundA: Refunds for simple change-of-mind are limited, and are handled according to the procedures set out by applicable law. See our Terms of Service for details.
faq.aiControlQ: Can the AI change my server on its own?
faq.aiControlA: No. Anything with a real effect — editing files, running commands — always requires you to press an approval button. We also auto-backup before risky actions.
faq.minecraftA: We support server types registered by the operator, including Paper, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, and Vanilla. You can pick a version when creating a server.
faq.generalA: VPS (Code-Server), Discord bots (20+ popular presets like Red and Muse, plus custom GitHub repos), generic Node.js/Python/Go/Java/C#, and utilities like Uptime Kuma and Gitea.
faq.paymentA: No card needed — pay by bank transfer. Once the depositor name and amount match, it's confirmed automatically and your server is created.
